project_info.theme: Luxury magazine beauty close-up with navy and white styling
project_info.creative_direction: Refined photoreal beauty portrait focused on expressive eyes, red lips, hair texture, and natural skin
project_info.color_palette: minimal white, deep navy, crisp white shirt, warm skin, dark brown hair, and matte red lips

main_subject.detail: adult woman with luminous natural skin, expressive brown eyes, natural full brows, defined nose bridge, matte red lips, and long silky dark hair parted in the middle
main_subject.wardrobe: navy coat collar layered over a crisp white shirt
main_subject.expression: quietly confident and elegant direct gaze

composition_elements.framing: 3:4 vertical tight head-and-shoulder portrait with face as the sole anchor
composition_elements.background: clean minimalist white studio with generous negative space
composition_elements.beauty_details: natural pores, subtle cheekbone highlights, fine hair strands, matte lip texture, and soft cinematic shadows

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: balanced beauty dish at approximately 5000K with soft fill
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: gentle sculpting across cheekbones and forehead, soft shadow depth, and luxury cosmetic clarity

technical_specs.render_style: full-frame camera with 105mm beauty lens, Vogue-style editorial photography without copying a real cover
technical_specs.finish: sharp focus, realistic skin, fine hair detail, restrained retouching, and natural dynamic range

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a beautiful close-up luxury magazine beauty portrait of a clearly adult fictional woman. Give her luminous natural skin with delicate visible texture, expressive brown eyes looking directly at the camera with quiet confidence, natural full brows, a defined nose bridge, bold matte red lips, and long silky dark hair parted in the middle with soft loose waves. Show a navy coat collar over a crisp white shirt at the bottom of the frame. Use a clean minimalist white background, balanced approximately 5000K professional studio lighting with soft cinematic shadows, a 105mm beauty lens, natural pores, subtle cheekbone highlights, fine hair strands, and a timeless high-fashion editorial finish. Do not use a celebrity likeness, real magazine title, logo, watermark, or public-figure identity.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, celebrity likeness, public-figure name, real magazine title, logo, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed face, distorted hair
